categories.name: Encore Mode
categories.rules:
All runs must start from one of the following:

- An empty save file.
- A "No Save" file. 

Timing is done by real time, and begins when you select your file, and ends when the in-game timer freezes after defeating the Titanic Monarch 2 boss.

As of **28 March 2021** game audio is required and must be at an audible level throughout the run. At the very least, the SFX must be clearly audible.

As of **17 November 2021**, music and SFX mods are now allowed. This includes the toggling of the "Disable Background Pausing" cheat through the Mania Mod Manager program.

Input device switching is allowed (e.g. playing on a controller then changing it to a different input method such as a keyboard) but only to a certain degree, please exercise caution and avoid abuse.

All unofficial versions, texture hacks, other mods, other modloader cheats / features, developer mode features, etc are not allowed. Using Secret features such as Peelout and Debug are not allowed.

categories.name: Sonic & Tails
categories.rules:

- An empty save file.
- A "No Save" file.

Controlling Tails with 1P input is allowed, however controlling Tails with 2P input is not allowed.

categories.name: Sonic
categories.rules:
As of **May 14, 2024**, **the replay system is banned for all runs that place in the top 5**. In addition, the **full results screen itself and the animation must be completely visible and shown at the end of your run**.

Pausing: **Pausing is allowed only to a certain extent**. The sort of pausing that is banned is the type where it is done **egregiously**. A few examples are: **optimizing spindashes to a TAS-like level** or **any sort of pausing that appears to be unreasonable or excessive** can lead to an IL submission that fits this description to lead to runs being rejected. This also includes **input device switching**, which is explained in the following paragraph. **ALL** runs deemed to fit under this criteria will be **rejected** from the leaderboard.

Input device switching: This refers to switching from one input device to another (e.g. playing on a controller then changing it to a different input method such as a keyboard) **This will be counted as and placed under the pausing category, meaning it is not allowed**.

values.name: Unpatched
values.rules: **Runs must be done on Version 1.0. This refers to the version first released on console before any patch.**

values.name: Patched
values.rules: **Runs must be played on Version 1.03. This refers to releases on PC prior to the Mania Plus update patch, and releases on console after the initial patch. For runs done on 1.0. please submit to Unpatched. For runs done on versions 1.04-1.06, please submit to Plus.**

values.name: Plus
values.rules:
Runs must be done on Versions 1.04-1.06, this refers to the following:
- v1.04 is the free update without the paid DLC on consoles.
- v1.05 is the free update + paid DLC patch on consoles. For PC, this applies even if only the free update is installed.
- v1.06 is the free update + paid DLC + Denuvo DRM removal patch (PC only).

categories.name: Sonic
categories.rules:
All runs must start from one of the following:

- An empty save file.
- A "No Save" file. 
- A "Zone 1" file with no emeralds, 3 lives, and 0 continues.

As of **28 March 2021** game audio is required and must be at an audible level throughout the run. At the very least, the SFX must be clearly audible.

As of **17 November 2021**, music and SFX mods are now allowed. This includes the toggling of the "Disable Background Pausing" cheat through the Mania Mod Manager program.

Input device switching is allowed (e.g. playing on a controller then changing it to a different input method such as a keyboard), please exercise caution however and avoid abuse.

All unofficial versions, texture hacks, other mods, other modloader cheats / features, developer mode features, etc are not allowed. Using Secret features such as Peelout and Debug are not allowed.

categories.name: Sonic
categories.rules:
As of **May 14, 2024**, **the replay system is banned for all runs that place in the top 5**. In addition, the **full results screen itself and the animation must be completely visible and shown at the end of your run**.

Pausing: **Pausing is allowed only to a certain extent**. The sort of pausing that is banned is the type where it is done **egregiously**. A few examples are: **optimizing spindashes to a TAS-like level** or **any sort of pausing that appears to be unreasonable or excessive** can lead to an IL submission that fits this description to lead to runs being rejected. This also includes **input device switching**, which is explained in the following paragraph. **ALL** runs deemed to fit under this criteria will be **rejected** from the leaderboard.

Input device switching: This refers to switching from one input device to another (e.g. playing on a controller then changing it to a different input method such as a keyboard) **This will be counted as and placed under the pausing category, meaning it is not allowed**.
